chunks: Each will have a position in accordance with his deeds; and no wrong will be done to them.

key_terms.يُظْلَمُونَ: they are wronged or treated unjustly

ai.seo_question: How does divine justice ensure fair reward for individual deeds?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse from Surah Al-A'raf is often linked to the concept of 'Darajat' as both spiritual stations in the afterlife and degrees of reward or punishment, reflecting the precision of divine accounting. It underscores that God’s justice is not merely retributive but also restorative, ensuring that every deed, whether minor or major, is fully compensated without any loss to the individual. This assurance reinforces the Shia belief in the absolute fairness of God, contrasting with human notions of arbitrary judgment.
